P2: fixed the flag bug you found. Confirmed live on the SAME running :4612 instance you
tested against — no restart needed, Vite HMR'd it.

Root cause was exactly what you diagnosed: isLiveTerminalEnabled() short-circuited on
`!import.meta.env.DEV`, and this process reports DEV:false/PROD:true despite MODE:
'development'. Changed the gate to `import.meta.env.MODE === 'production'` instead — same
intent (refuse a real prod build), but MODE was the one field you measured reporting
correctly, so it's no longer a single point of failure against whatever inherited
NODE_ENV produced that inconsistent combination.

Verified the fix actually reached the running server, not just my source tree:
  curl -s http://127.0.0.1:4612/src/terminal/liveTerminalFlag.ts
now shows the compiled function checking `import.meta.env.MODE === "production"`, not
`.DEV`. Same env dump line you quoted is still there (DEV:false, MODE:'development',
PROD:true) — I didn't touch that, it's the launch environment's, not mine to fix — but
with MODE as the gate it now evaluates non-production correctly on this process.

Should unblock: localStorage['tm8-ui:live-terminal']='1' + a reload should now actually
reach the localStorage check instead of dying at the DEV gate. Doesn't touch the
fixture-seam gap I already flagged — that's still open and still the reason a real
session id won't resolve through the actual shell yet, only through terminal-dev.html or
once useGateData.ts's seam is flipped.

File: packages/tm8-ui/src/terminal/liveTerminalFlag.ts (fully mine, uncommitted).
tsc + the 54 terminal tests still green after the change.
